Create your character and go through the tutorial.
Choose your weapon and fight against mobs to get used to the skills.
Take courage to explore dungeons to take its treasures.
Go through the different biomes to get resources to use or sell.
Use the resources that you picked up to create and improve your equipment.
Once you improved your equipment try to complete an expedition.
Socialize using the general chat to do parties to do group things.
Get together with more people to achieve bigger goals.
Wipe out group or solo camps to get special rewards.
Check your PvP skills fighting against others players.
Explore the safe areas of this game to see what this world can offer you.
Search for specials inscriptions that will tell you about this bast world.
Watch the different cities to check what you can do.
Do some different chill activities such as fishing.
Go at the markets of the cities and check what they have on sell or put things on selling.
Once you have chosen your favourite city join at its faction to do special faction contents.
Use Hunting Equipment to search for special beasts to create stronger weapons.
Get your group to kill special gathering monsters to improve your resources.
Go alone or your friends to explore the infernal dungeon called the Abyss and sacrifice others players to special rewards.
Once improved your PvP skills and practiced with your friend or guild, try to join at a tournament.
When you are finally ready after testing PvP at big scale, and fighting strong mobs it is time to go at the main content, the Far Lands.
Explore the portals located on the Far Lands to discover new species and the Paths Of Avalon.
Search for the Will'o Wisps to find the losts lands called the Mists.
Do missions od the Smugglers and use their hideouts to have a safe area in the Far Lands.
Collaborate with your guild to create your own hideout in the Far Lands and protect it for invasions.
Search for more members to being capable to conquest a fortress in the Far Lands.
Make a name of your guild and Create an Alliance with others guilds to conquest more territories and make your name in Albion.
Once you are a big allay step inside the specials dungeons that suddenly can appear and get their big rewards.
Achieve the goal of being a premium player and rest managing your farm and get stables incomes.
When you and your friends are ready search for the ancient lands to hunts dragons and become a dragon slayer or raise your own as a mount.
